title: Nourishing Crisp Slovakian Danmuji Salad
description: A refreshing Slovakian salad featuring danmuji, katsuramuki-cut vegetables, and a low-carb friendly dressing, perfect for a light and energizing meal. This dish is made with grassy and crisp ingredients to provide a boost of energy.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the katsuramuki-cut cucumber, carrots, red bell pepper, and celery.
In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Add the danmuji to the bowl with the vegetables and toss to combine.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Chill the salad in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the salad a good toss to redistribute the dressing.
Serve the salad cold, garnished with additional danmuji if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
